name: Galaxy Stella

seo.title: Galaxy Stella Yacht Galapagos: Cruises | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Galaxy Stella, a 12-guest Galapagos motor yacht with 6 cabins, a master suite, jacuzzi and fire pit. 3 to 7-night routes from Baltra and San Cristobal.

tagline: Twelve guests, six cabins and a wooden-look yacht with a fire pit on deck.
answer: Galaxy Stella is Galaxy Cruises' smallest luxury yacht, a motor yacht with a classic wooden look for 12 guests in 6 cabins, including a master suite with a study. A cruise director and one bilingual naturalist guide sail with her. Routes run 3, 4 or 7 nights between Baltra and San Cristobal, from US$3,600 per person in 2026. She can also be chartered whole.
facts: 6, including a master suite with double bed, double shower and study

overview: Galaxy Stella is a motor yacht that pairs a classic wooden look with a modern design, run by Galaxy Cruises, a Quito-based Galapagos operator with an office in Puerto Ayora. At 12 guests she is the smallest luxury yacht in Galaxy's fleet.

Her six cabins include a master suite with a double bed, a large bathroom with a double shower and its own study. Inside there is a main lounge, a dining room and a bar; the sundeck has a jacuzzi, a barbecue area and a fire pit. Wi-Fi is by Starlink.

The 3-night Southern Route runs San Cristobal to Baltra via Espanola and Floreana. The 4-night Eastern Route runs Baltra to San Cristobal via North Seymour, Santa Fe, South Plaza and Genovesa. The 7-night Complete Western Route loops from Baltra through southern and western Isabela, Fernandina, Santiago and Bartolome, and Eastern plus Southern join into a 7-night loop.
why: Twelve guests is about as small as Galapagos cruising gets, and six cabins make her an easy whole-boat booking for one family or group of friends.
A fire pit and barbecue on the sundeck, a master suite with a study, and routes that cover the south, the east with Genovesa, or the full west in a week.

faqs: How many guests does Galaxy Stella carry?
Twelve, in six cabins, one of them a master suite with a study. A cruise director and a bilingual naturalist guide sail with her.
Which routes does Galaxy Stella sail?
A 3-night Southern Route from San Cristobal, a 4-night Eastern Route with Genovesa, a 7-night Complete Western Route, and a 7-night Eastern plus Southern loop.
How much does a Galaxy Stella cruise cost?
Galaxy's 2026 prices are US$3,600 per person for 3 nights, US$4,800 for 4 nights and US$8,400 for 7 nights. Flights, the park fee and the transit card are extra.
Yes. Galaxy offers her as an exclusive charter; the whole-boat price is quoted on request.
